source: Deep supplier research via ChatGPT web search (19 Oct 2026). Public sources only — company websites, BSE/NSE filings, CARE/CRISIL rationales, annual reports, and IndiaMART/TradeIndia for clearly-labelled advertised ask prices (not confirmed quotes). These are leads to verify before any RFQ; no price or figure was invented.

universal-starch-chem-allied.gradeNote: Its own site explicitly lists Dextrose Anhydrous IP/BP/USP — the clearest pharma-grade match of the dextrose suppliers.
universal-starch-chem-allied.plant: Dondaicha, Dhule, Maharashtra — the nearest dextrose plant to FDC's West-India operations.
universal-starch-chem-allied.financials: FY2025-26: revenue ₹488.60 Cr · net margin 2.69% (improved vs FY25).
universal-starch-chem-allied.priceRef: Advertised ask ₹65/kg (25 kg) and ₹57/kg (1 MT) on marketplaces — ex-GST unverified, not a confirmed bulk quote.
universal-starch-chem-allied.angle: Strongest grade + closest plant. Get one written IP-grade quote (annual volume, delivered West India, batch COA, shelf life, credit) and use the ₹57–65/kg ask as the opening reference.

grade.label: Anhydrous made — IP COA to confirm

gujarat-ambuja-exports.correction: Earlier read was “monohydrate only”. Corrected: GAEL does make dextrose anhydrous (per its catalogue and FY24-25 report). But no document confirms the Dextrose Anhydrous IP monograph yet — ask for the IP-grade COA.
gujarat-ambuja-exports.rating: CARE AA− · outlook revised Stable → Positive, reaffirmed 8 Oct 2026 (₹395 Cr bank facilities). A better outlook, not a rating upgrade.
gujarat-ambuja-exports.angle: Get the IP-grade COA, then a volume-linked ₹/kg cut benchmarked against Universal's verified grade.

grade.label: Anhydrous made — IP SKU to confirm

sayaji-industries.correction: “Maize Products” is Sayaji's own division (injectable-grade Dextrose Anhydrous IP/BP/USP, Kathwada, Ahmedabad) — not a separate alternative supplier. Treat it as the same company.
sayaji-industries.financials: FY2025-26 (85th annual report, filed 26 Aug 2026): total income ₹1,075.10 Cr · PAT ₹1.50 Cr · net margin ≈0.14% (razor-thin). Back to profit after two loss years.
sayaji-industries.angle: Operating profit jumped ~95% on lower maize cost and better utilisation, but the net margin is wafer-thin — there's little room to simply cut price. Push a cost-structure / maize-input pass-through discussion tied to your committed volume, not a flat discount.

grade.label: Anhydrous made — IP SKU to confirm

sukhjit-corn-products.financials: FY2025-26: turnover ₹1,425.68 Cr · PAT ₹26.09 Cr · implied net margin ≈1.83% (turnover and PAT down YoY).
sukhjit-corn-products.plant: Plants in Phagwara (Punjab), Nizamabad (Telangana), Malda (WB), Himachal — none verified in West India.
sukhjit-corn-products.angle: Useful second source to avoid dependence on West-India makers. Run a same-grade landed-price comparison and ask for matching delivered-to-FDC pricing.

tetrapak-india.correction: Tetra Pak supplies aseptic beverage/ORS cartons (a finished packaging system, sold per piece), NOT the sachet/blister laminate film the other suppliers make. Don't compare its price against the film suppliers — that's apples to oranges.
tetrapak-india.angle: Benchmark it only against other aseptic-carton systems — SIG (new Ahmedabad plant) and GLS Elopak (Rewari) — and only if your filling machine is compatible. Switching needs compatible machinery + revalidation, so negotiate per-carton price, rebates, support and payment terms with Tetra Pak directly.

huhtamaki-india.financials: Calendar year 2025: revenue ₹2,469.41 Cr · PAT ₹118.16 Cr · net margin 4.78% (EBITDA up to ₹226 Cr from ₹151 Cr). Note: calendar-year accounts, not FY25-26.
huhtamaki-india.angle: Profit recovered on mix, pricing and raw-material. Ask for a documented raw-material cost pass-through plus a volume rebate — on the same approved laminate structure, not a cheaper spec.

uflex.financials: FY2024-25: consolidated revenue ₹15,183.8 Cr · normalised PAT ₹320.1 Cr (normalised, not statutory net margin).
uflex.angle: Demand a transparent aluminium/resin input-price reset, and compare your qualified strip/blister structures against ACG and Bilcare as leverage.

gls-films-industries-p.financials: Private — no company-level revenue verified (the ₹3,000 Cr figure is GLS Group-wide, not GLS Films).
gls-films-industries-p.angle: Its Phase-II +18,000 t/yr expansion (→36,000 t/yr) was targeted for July 2026, but commissioning is NOT verified as of Oct 2026. Don't assume spare capacity — ask for the actual commercial-start date, current output and qualified pharma-line slots, then negotiate a volume-based price concession.

geep-industries-india.financials: Private — the parent Thanawala group's ₹400 Cr is group-wide, not GEEP laminate revenue. Site capacity ~4,000 t/yr; Thane, Maharashtra.
geep-industries-india.angle: Local, flexible on small artwork runs. Ask for repeat-SKU pricing on consolidated laminate consumption backed by documented material-cost moves.

shrinath-roto-pack.financials: Private — claims ₹1,000 Cr turnover (financial year / audited basis not verified). Plants in Telangana; Aug 2026 export shipments show activity, not spare capacity.
shrinath-roto-pack.angle: Negotiate annual-volume rebates and guaranteed delivery slots against verified comparable laminate offers.

berry-global-india.correction: Berry Global India and Bprex are the SAME group — Bprex is Berry's Bangalore healthcare operation. Treating them as two separate bidders would create fake competition. Negotiate once at group level.

bprex-pharma-packaging-india-p.correction: Bprex is Berry's Bangalore (Peenya) healthcare arm — related to Berry Global India, not an independent competitor. Keep SKU/entity traceability and negotiate as one group.

pgp-glass.correction: PGP makes pharmaceutical GLASS (Type I/II/III bottles & vials) — not a PET/HDPE plastic comparator. Benchmark it only against other pharma-glass suppliers, never against your plastic bottles.

empire-industries-virum-glass.correction: Empire's Vitrum division makes amber GLASS bottles and ROPP packaging — a separate category from PET/HDPE plastic. Benchmark against glass suppliers only.
empire-industries-virum-glass.financials: Listed (BSE: 509525) — company-wide: market cap ≈₹597 Cr · ROCE 16.8% · ROE 15.1% · P/E 154 (Screener, consolidated, Oct 2026). Empire is a diversified group, so these are not glass-only figures. (The free market feed carries no Empire quote, so it still shows as pending in the auto-financials.)
empire-industries-virum-glass.angle: Healthy group returns (16.8% ROCE) but a very rich stock (P/E 154). Glass is a small, separate line for you — benchmark its price against other amber-glass makers, and keep the financials at group level only.

cincorp-international.angle: Catalogue covers 28/33/38mm CT & child-resistant closures, 30/60ml dry-syrup bottles and measuring cups, with ISO Class 8 cleanroom. Quote the 28mm closure + dry-syrup bottle + measuring cup as one approved component set.

triveni-polymers.angle: Gerresheimer group — Kosamba, Gujarat (West India) plus Kundli, Haryana; induction-seal bottles & CR caps. Put Kosamba into the West-India landed-cost competition for matched bottle/closure systems.

scorpion-containers.angle: Pardi, Gujarat — PET/HDPE bottles, caps, preforms and measuring cups, DMF-labelled. A credible challenger: run a multi-SKU tender covering comparable bottles, closures, preforms and cups.

kilitch-healthcare-india.correction: Kilitch is mainly a sterile-injectable manufacturer — independent sale of rigid-plastic components isn't established. Reconcile the actual purchase-ledger item before treating it as a plastics supplier.

dextrose.name: Maize Products
dextrose.note: Not an independent alternative — it is Sayaji. Valuable as a higher-grade (injectable) option from an existing supplier; get current certificates and a comparable-volume quote.

dextrose.name: Loba Chemie
dextrose.note: IP specification and COA access advertised (spec revised Sep 2026); commercial suitability for bulk pharma to confirm.

dextrose.name: Anmol Chemicals
dextrose.note: The specific SKU's IP compliance is NOT confirmed — lower-priority lead until an IP grade is shown.

packaging.name: Mold-Tek Packaging
packaging.format: Pharma HDPE tablet bottles, CT/CRC caps (33/38/53mm); 28mm CR liquid-syrup closure announced
packaging.note: 28mm CR is not automatically the same as a 28mm induction-wad PP cap — match neck, liner and site qualification first.

packaging.name: SSF Plastics India
packaging.format: Pharma PET/HDPE/PP bottles, tablet & dry-syrup bottles, caps/closures
packaging.where: Daman, Baddi, Pardi, Hosur, Hyderabad (15 facilities)
packaging.note: Strong pharma capability; match neck, liner, induction compatibility and site cleanroom certificate.

packaging.name: Weener Empire Plastics
packaging.format: Pharmaceutical HDPE/PP bottles, jars, closures & dispensing systems
packaging.note: Confirm the exact 28mm induction-wad design and pharma site qualification.

packaging.name: Dhiren Packaging
packaging.format: 28mm PP child-resistant, tamper-evident induction-wad cap; pharma measuring caps
packaging.note: Advertised ask ₹2/piece (listing date & GST unverified). Very relevant closure, but CRC build and liner must match FDC exactly.

laminates.name: ACG (Packaging Materials)
laminates.format: Pharma aluminium blister lidding foil (Alumlid) for thermoform & cold-form
laminates.where: India group — foil plant for the SKU to confirm
laminates.note: Strong blister-foil capability; match the approved foil gauge, lacquer, print and substrate.

laminates.name: Bilcare
laminates.note: Qualified only if your existing laminate spec matches — not a chemistry change. Published structure, water-vapour and heat-seal data.

laminates.name: SIG (Ahmedabad)
laminates.where: Ahmedabad, Gujarat — plant fully operational 12 Dec 2025
laminates.role: Maker / system provider — private (SIG Group, Switzerland)
laminates.note: A West-India aseptic-carton alternative to Tetra Pak — only if your filling machine is compatible; equipment/revalidation is the blocker.

laminates.name: GLS Elopak
laminates.format: Pure-Pak / Alpak aseptic liquid cartons (incl. ORS & liquid nutrition)
laminates.role: Maker / system supplier — JV (Elopak listed, Norway)
laminates.note: Second aseptic-carton alternative; confirm carton & filler compatibility and product-contact validation.

laminates.name: Constantia Flexibles (India)
laminates.where: India presence — qualifying plant to confirm
laminates.note: Credible established converter; confirm country of manufacture, structure, heat-seal and site approval.
